description: Groovy is a language for Java-based tools, scripts and build tasks. It has short syntax for common jobs. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install a JDK and Groovy. Save each example as lesson.groovy and run groovy lesson.groovy.
versionNote: Examples use Groovy 4 or later with a compatible JDK.
whatYouWillLearn: Count across a range with Groovy
learningObjectives: Read a list item with Groovy
